harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#642; borg-reborn-rs #881, PR #897). Six profiles on one build,
classes-18, 18 starts each (108 cells), 100,000 exact engine turns, evidence retained: ctl, m1 and m2 in breeders-x4 and in
breeders-x8 (a world's arms are compared only within that world; the report pairs m1-x4 and m2-x4 with ctl-x4, and m1-x8 and
m2-x8 with ctl-x8). Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell records its world with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every
arm of that world, and each arm's two values appear in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped with
frozen-turn bursts classified; death bundles reproduce in the same world; the arms must play differently: if m1 or m2 is identical
to ctl in all 18 pilot games of a world, stop and report before the larger tiers. Primary (P7's tactical endpoint): deaths by 100,000
turns, all attempts retained; mean CL and mean max depth may each fall by no more than 0.25 against ctl in the same world.
Report per world, arm and class: deaths and causes and breeder deaths (the killer has MULTIPLY); paired rescued and newly killed
against ctl (exact McNemar) and identical plays; final and maximum CL, deepest level; unfinished games, stalls, timeouts and errors
with denominators; a RULES 18 bin. Diagnostics: stair flights per game (committed flights, and flights that found no route:
"Stairs not reachable"), Word of Recall reads in flight per game, breeders created and killed per game, "# Breeders cannot be stopped"
and "No rest: ... breeders known" per game. A breeder world is a stress test; a confirmation on a new unopened seed block comes before
any shipped override (classes-1800-b has been read). Directional (RULES 14).

Each world has its own control.
